sections.Profile:
ROCs is an innovative pinball game developed by Multimorphic, released in 2017. Designed as an application for the P3 Pinball Platform, it combines traditional pinball mechanics with a dynamic, interactive playfield display. Players use real balls, flippers, and bumpers to defend a power source from ROCs (robots), while activating laser beams and collecting power-ups to maintain flipper strength.
